help.stdout:
usage: PROG [-h] [-f FILE] [-o OUT] [--scale SCALE] [--border BORDER] [--html]
              [--title TITLE] [--save] [--version] [text]

Generate an offline QR code, printed to the terminal or saved as a PNG.

positional arguments:
  text             text to encode; omit when using --file

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  -f, --file FILE  read the text from a file, stripped
  -o, --out OUT    save the PNG at this path; implies --save
  --scale SCALE    pixels per module 1-100 (default 10); implies --save
  --border BORDER  quiet zone in modules 0-16 (default 4)
  --html           write a viewer page next to the PNG; implies --save
  --title TITLE    viewer page title; requires --html
  --save           write the PNG instead of printing to the terminal
  --version        show program's version number and exit
